intro: One of the most-asked questions for this trip: how do you actually get from Bangkok to Surat Thani? Here are your options compared, with the honest pick for most travelers.

blocks.html: Short answer: Fastest is a direct flight into Koh Samui Airport — about 1 hour 10 minutes, though fares tend to be higher. The budget route is to reach Surat Thani by plane, train or bus, then take a ferry across to Samui, which together takes several hours to overnight.

blocks.caption: Options compared (฿ = relative cost; check live fares to confirm)

blocks.html: If budget is no issue and you want to arrive fast, the direct flight to Samui saves the most time. To save money, fly into Surat Thani (cheaper, frequent flights) then take the ferry — a popular combo. Combined overnight bus-and-ferry tickets are cheapest but more tiring.

faq.q: What is the cheapest way to Koh Samui?
faq.a: Usually a combined overnight bus or train from Bangkok to Surat Thani plus a ferry. It takes longer but saves on both fare and a night’s accommodation.

faq.q: Direct Samui flight vs flying to Surat Thani?
faq.a: Flying direct to Samui is most convenient but pricier (a private airport). Flying to Surat Thani is cheaper and more frequent, but adds a road transfer and a ferry crossing.
